question: What do we call a group of people who are related and live together in a home? 🏠
explanation: Awesome! A family is a group of people who love, share, and live together happily in a home! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
hint: It includes your parents and siblings.

question: Who tells the best bedtime stories in the family? 📖
explanation: Great job! Grandparents love to tell us amazing stories and teach us good things. 👵👴

question: How should we treat our grandparents and elders? 👵👴
explanation: Super! We must always talk to our elders with love, care, and respect. ❤️
hint: It means being very kind and polite.

question: What makes a family very happy? 😊
explanation: Excellent! When everyone shares the work at home, things get done faster and everyone is happy! 🤝

question: What do we call a big family with grandparents, parents, uncles, aunts, and cousins? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Wonderful! A joint family is a large happy family where many relatives live together. 🏡
hint: It has many people living in one big house.

question: What is a family with just parents and children called? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Perfect! A nuclear family is a small family with just parents and their children. 👨‍👩‍👦

question: How can you help your family at home? 🧹
explanation: Brilliant! You can help your parents by cleaning your room and picking up your toys. 🧽

question: What should we do when a family member is sick? 🤒
explanation: Awesome! We must give them medicine, healthy food, and lots of love so they get well soon! 🥣

question: Who usually cooks yummy food in your home? 🍲
explanation: Great job! Parents work hard to cook tasty and healthy food for the whole family! 👨‍🍳
hint: They are the ones who take care of you.

question: How do families celebrate festivals like Diwali or Eid? 🎉
explanation: Super! Families celebrate festivals together by wearing new clothes, eating sweets, and having fun! 🎇

question: Who are the people living in the houses near our home? 🏘️
explanation: Excellent! Neighbours are our friends who live right next to us in our community. 🏡

question: How should we talk to our elders and neighbours? 🗣️
explanation: Wonderful! Speaking politely shows that we have good manners and respect for others. 😊
hint: It means using sweet and kind words.

question: Where is our very first school? 📚
explanation: Perfect! Our home is our first school because we learn our first good habits from our parents. 🏡

question: Where do we feel the most safe and loved? 🛡️
explanation: Brilliant! Home is a safe place where our family protects us and gives us love. 🏡
hint: It is the place you sleep every night.

question: What is a good thing to share with your brothers and sisters? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! Sharing toys makes playing together much more fun for everyone! 🚂
hint: These are things you play with.

question: Who usually buys clothes and books for the house? 🛍️
explanation: Great job! Parents work to earn money so they can buy everything the family needs. 👨‍👩‍👧

question: How should we greet guests when they visit our home? 🙏
explanation: Super! Greeting guests with a big smile makes them feel welcome and happy. 😊
hint: It shows you are happy to see them.

question: What should you do with your clothes when they get dirty? 👕
explanation: Excellent! Washing dirty clothes keeps us clean, fresh, and healthy! 🫧

question: What is the most beautiful thing family members share? ❤️
explanation: Wonderful! Love is the magic that keeps a family strong and happy together! 💕
hint: It is a happy, caring feeling.

question: Who helps you with your school homework at home? ✏️
explanation: Perfect! Parents and older siblings love to help you learn and finish your homework. 👨‍👩‍👦
hint: The people living in your house.

question: What should we do if we have extra tasty food? 🍛
explanation: Brilliant! Sharing food with family and neighbours brings everyone closer. 🤝

question: What makes doing big chores at home very easy? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! When everyone works together as a team, big chores become super easy and fun! 🫂

question: What should we say if we make a mistake at home? 🙊
explanation: Great job! Saying sorry shows that we are honest and want to make things right. 🙏

question: How do good neighbours act towards each other? 🤗
explanation: Super! Good neighbours are like family. They always help each other in times of need. 🤝

question: What do we call our mother's or father's parents? 👵👴
explanation: Excellent! Grandparents are the oldest and most wonderful members of our family! 👵👴
hint: They are the elders of the family.

question: Who usually goes to work to earn money for the family? 💼
explanation: Wonderful! Parents work hard at their jobs so they can buy food, clothes, and toys for the family. 👨‍💼👩‍💼
hint: The adults who look after you.

question: What is the best way to solve a fight with your sister or brother? 🕊️
explanation: Perfect! Talking nicely helps us understand each other and solve problems peacefully. 🗣️

question: How can we keep our beautiful house clean? 🗑️
explanation: Brilliant! Putting garbage in the dustbin keeps our home clean, healthy, and beautiful! 🗑️

question: What is the magic word to use when someone helps you? 🙏
explanation: Awesome! Saying 'Thank you' is a beautiful way to show you are happy they helped you! 😊

question: Who is your best friend to play with at home? 🎾
explanation: Great job! Brothers and sisters (siblings) are our first and best friends at home! 👧👦

question: How do we feel inside when we help our family? 💖
explanation: Super! Helping others fills our hearts with joy and makes our family smile! 😊

question: What is very important for a happy home? 🏡
explanation: Excellent! A peaceful home where everyone loves each other is the best place to be. 🕊️

question: What do families love to do on summer holidays? 🏖️
explanation: Wonderful! Holidays are a fun time for families to travel, relax, and make new memories together! ✈️

question: What do we give to our loved ones on special festivals? 🎁
explanation: Perfect! Giving gifts is a sweet way to show our family and friends how much we love them. 💝

question: How can you help your mother in the kitchen? 🍽️
explanation: Brilliant! Setting the plates and spoons on the table is a great way to help with mealtime! 🍽️

question: What should we do with toys we no longer play with? 🚂
explanation: Awesome! Donating old toys to other children brings a big smile to their faces! 🎁
hint: Give them to children who need them.

question: Who protects the family and keeps everyone safe? 🦸‍♂️
explanation: Great job! Parents are like superheroes who always keep their children safe and protected. 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️

question: How do we show love and care to our family members? 🫂
explanation: Super! Hugging our parents and siblings is a beautiful way to say 'I love you'! 🤗

question: What is a group of families living in the same area called? 🏘️
explanation: Excellent! A community is made of many families living together, sharing, and helping each other. 🤝

question: Who teaches us good manners and daily habits? 🌱
explanation: Wonderful! Parents guide us every day and teach us how to be kind, polite, and good people. 👨‍👩‍👦
hint: The people who love you most.

question: How should older brothers and sisters behave with younger ones? 👧👦
explanation: Perfect! Older siblings should always protect and love their little brothers and sisters. 💕

question: What is a happy family activity to do at the dining table? 🍛
explanation: Brilliant! Eating meals together helps the family talk about their day and bond with each other! 🍽️

question: What is a fun thing to do with your family on weekends? 🎲
explanation: Awesome! Playing board games or outdoor games brings joy and laughter to the family! 🎯

question: How can everyone in the family save water at home? 🚰
explanation: Great job! Turning off taps when not in use is a smart way families can save the Earth's water! 💧

question: What do we celebrate together with our neighbourhood community? 🎇
explanation: Super! Communities come together to celebrate colorful festivals with music, food, and joy! 🎉
hint: Special happy days like Diwali or Holi.

question: What do good neighbours do when you need help? 💕
explanation: Excellent! Good neighbours are like family; they step in to help whenever you need them! 🤝

question: How should children keep their bedroom? 🛏️
explanation: Wonderful! Keeping your room neat and tidy shows you are responsible and helpful! ✨

question: How can you help the plants in your house grow? 🌱
explanation: Perfect! Watering the plants helps them grow healthy, green, and beautiful in our home! 🚿

question: How do families welcome a new baby into the home? 👶
explanation: Brilliant! A new baby brings a lot of joy, smiles, and celebrations to the whole family! 🎊

question: What is the best gift a family can give to each other? 💝
explanation: Awesome! Spending happy time together is the most precious and beautiful gift for any family! ⏳
